title: e2e oracle harness: structural byte-parsers read CWS as FWS (3 false failures)
description:
QA sweep at main d8cd458. Three e2e oracle tests parse __flashTest.publish() output as an UNCOMPRESSED FWS SWF and walk the tag stream by hand, but publish() returns a COMPRESSED CWS SWF by default (publishSettings.compress=true in Shell.tsx:549; confirmed magic bytes = 67 87 83 'CWS'). The parsers read zlib bytes as garbage tag types (observed: 811, 16, 369, 401, 374, 856, 793, 824 — none are valid SWF tag types) so they never find the real tags. These tests provide ZERO real coverage today. Affected tests (all consistently FAIL, reproduced twice):
- apps/desktop/e2e/shape-morph.spec.ts:317 'compiled SWF contains DefineMorphShape2 tag (tag 84)' — Expected true, Received false; logged 'Tag types found: 811, 16, 369, ...'
- apps/desktop/e2e/motion-guide.spec.ts:530 'SWF structure: 5 ShowFrame tags, guide layer excluded' — ShowFrame=0 PlaceObject2=0 DefineSprite=0, Expected 5 Received 0
- apps/desktop/e2e/fla-roundtrip.spec.ts:367 'FLA round-trip preserves document structure' — structureCheck.swfLength is undefined (the in-browser eval returns no length / parser bails on CWS), Expected >100.
NOTE: these are NOT render defects — Ruffle decompresses CWS fine and the corresponding VISUAL oracle tests in the same specs render correctly (e.g. shape-morph frame0 renders 11422 non-white px; motion-guide compile+load renders 2500 px). Fix options: (a) inflate the CWS body (bytes 8+, zlib) before tag-walking, or (b) decompress only when magic[0]==0x43, or (c) add a publish-uncompressed path to the test bridge. Repro: cd apps/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/shape-morph.spec.ts e2e/motion-guide.spec.ts e2e/fla-roundtrip.spec.ts --grep 'tag 84|SWF structure|preserves document structure'. CI env must be UNSET (the suite's test.skip(!!process.env.CI) guards skip all oracles when CI is set).
